artworks.title: Le portier de Mr Vautour
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals in a room. On the left, a woman in a bonnet and dress faces right. Two children beside her wear sailor-like attire. On the right, a man with distinctive facial features and unusual posture faces left. The room is simply furnished with decorative objects on the walls and a mantelpiece holding candlesticks.

artworks.title: Le Rébus illustré (The Illustrated Rebus)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing facing each other, both looking at a newspaper held by the man on the right. The man on the left has short hair and a focused expression, while the man on the right has curly hair and wide eyes. They both wear dark, patterned jackets over lighter shirts. The man on the right is holding a newspaper, and they are engaged with its content. The background is plain off-white with some printed text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Ne sachant plus comment utiliser leurs loisirs ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures engaged in a struggle. The central figure is dressed in plaid, interacting with another figure wearing a hat and holding a cane that are flying into the air. A third figure lies on the ground. The background includes minimal sketches suggesting interior elements. The drawing aims to capture a moment of chaos and lack of decorum.

artworks.title: A Bercy: Nous faisons ... ce que nous pouvons ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a painting of two individuals in a cellar with wooden barrels. The scene depicts a space filled with large barrels. One individual appears to be pouring something into or from a vessel over a barrel, while the other leans on a barrel. The room is lined with barrels and there is a noticeable texture in the way they are drawn, with the figures standing amidst the storage area.

artworks.title: Réunion de Savants se proposant...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of six men gathered around a long dining table. They are inspecting or discussing the contents on the table. The men are shown from the waist up, with expressive facial features. Some wear glasses and have receding or balding hairlines, while others have short, slightly disheveled hair and sideburns. They all wear dark suits, white shirts, and ties. The table is set with large plated dishes, including what seems to be roasted animals and poultry. The background is plain and nondescript, drawing attention to the men and the objects on the table.

artworks.title: Les nouveaux chalets
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of houses with various figures in communication. The drawing shows a man in a hat and coat walking past wooden structures. Figures lean out of windows, engaging with the man. The figures have different expressions and gestures, creating a dynamic interaction. The windows and postures suggest urgency or confrontation. The style is satirical and reminiscent of 19th-century comic art.

artworks.title: M. Coste, s'apercevant qu'a force de tirer
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man bent over, hands on his knees, looking at some dead fish on the ground. He has exaggerated facial features and short hair, wearing an old-fashioned suit with a top hat on the ground beside him. Trees are sketched in the background, with the ground indicating a dry stream or pond.

artworks.title: Impressions de vendages
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grape-stomping scene. The image shows individuals around wooden containers for crushing grapes. One figure is seated on a larger barrel with exaggerated physical features, while another figure is nearby possibly repairing footwear. Grape juice is splattered on the ground and there is overgrown landscape in the background. Text at the bottom adds comedic dialog to the scene.

artworks.title: Comment, madame ... J'ai l'imprudence ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures facing each other against a simple background. On the left, a man stands with his body turned to the side, extending his right arm and pointing. He has exaggerated features with a tight-fitting suit, a tailcoat, a cravat or scarf around his neck, and a cap on his head. His face shows strong lines. On the right, a woman faces towards the man with a scarf covering her head. She wears a long, dark gown. The background is plain and slightly textured, suggesting the interior of a room.

artworks.title: Les thèatres au mois d'aout
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two women seated in a theater gallery. Both women are depicted from head to toe, with their arms crossed and heads slightly lowered. The woman on the left has her head downcast and wears a dress with long sleeves, while the woman on the right rests her head against the wall, similarly dressed. The background shows the curvature of the theater gallery walls and a partially visible balcony. The illustration primarily uses a sketchy style with a focus on line work and shading.

artworks.title: Mr 'Prudhomme a la chasse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures outdoors. The older figure is holding a firearm and the younger figure is pointing at a flock of birds. Both are standing on uneven terrain. The older figure is holding several birds and there is French dialogue below them. The artwork is signed with initials.

artworks.title: Mr Prudhomme. Tu vois, Oh! Mon fils ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of a man in formal attire observing a duck falling from the sky, along with a young boy standing next to him. The background features trees and an indistinct figure walking in the distance. The figures and objects are depicted with bold, expressive lines. The caption provides dialogue between the man and the boy.

artworks.title: Le régisseur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a theatrical setting. One figure is dressed as a king and the other in contemporary attire. The image shows an interaction between the two figures. The background includes stage props or scenery. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic style with sketchy lines.

artworks.title: La princesse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene featuring a standing figure and a reclining figure. The drawing depicts a dramatic interaction between the two figures, one standing with a stooped posture and an animated expression, while the other is laying on the ground in a sprawled position. The standing figure is dressed in a long garment with a hood, leaning forward, seemingly speaking to the figure on the ground. The background is sparse, with a simple lined pattern and some indistinct shapes suggesting an audience. The drawing is black and white, with detailed shading techniques. Text beneath the drawing provides additional context.

artworks.title: Tiens ... vous m'aviez dit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man conversing with a concierge while two individuals stand nearby. The image features three figures, with one individual in a top hat gesturing towards a concierge behind a counter labeled "CONCIERGE." The two other figures stand slightly elevated on a staircase, observing the interaction. The scene is rendered in a monochrome style with strong use of lines to define details and textures, capturing expressions and postures that indicate a narrative exchange occurring. The rendering emphasizes the dynamic through expressions and gestures, with a particular focus on the detailed portrayal of clothing and interior elements.

artworks.title: J'en voulons point d'vot' billet ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men in a room. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic style. In the foreground, a man on the left gestures with his hands. The man on the right stands holding papers or a letter. The setting is sparse. The style and expressions used indicate a likely satirical or humorous tone, in line with the caption in French.

artworks.title: Je n'ai pas peur de la mort pour moi ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three full-body figures in a room. On the left, a man stands facing to the right with his hands clasped in front of his stomach. He has an elongated face with a prominent nose and is wearing a cap and a richly decorated coat with a swirling pattern. His hair appears short and is visible under the cap. In the center, a woman with her back turned to the viewer and her head tilted downwards. Her hair is styled into a bun, and she is wearing a dress with a fitted bodice and voluminous skirt. Next to her, another woman, facing the viewer but looking upwards, appears distressed, her mouth wide open, and her arms wrapped around the woman in front. Her hair is pulled back into a bun, and she wears a dress with long sleeves and a full skirt. Behind them, the room has two curtained windows, a framed picture on the wall, and a round table partly visible on the left. The room's details are sketched with light, fluid lines, and the overall atmosphere conveys a sense of an interior setting from the mid-19th century.

artworks.title: Un jour de verglas
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two exaggerated, caricature-like figures in an urban street setting. One figure appears to be slipping on a slick surface with a dramatic expression while the other figure, holding a broom, is bent slightly as if to assist or caution the slipping individual. The background indicates an urban environment. The drawing uses a monochrome palette reminiscent of Honoré Daumier's style.

artworks.title: Ah! ... Comme cette cheminé fume ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in mid-action within an interior setting. On the left, a person is standing and opening a window. This person is wearing a long dress and appears to have wavy hair adorned with a headpiece or cap. The second person is lying horizontally on a chaise lounge or couch, with their head tilted back. Their facial features suggest a profile view with curly hair. This person is dressed in dark clothing. A cloud of smoke or steam comes from a fireplace, emphasizing its presence in the composition. The room features a chimney or mantelpiece to the right, adorned with small decorative items. The background suggests a domestic interior with patterned flooring tiles and curtains framing the window on one side. The image is rendered in shades of black and white, giving it a textured, sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Mr Hume se passant la fantaisie ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals in a satirical setting. The person on the left is standing with their arms crossed, showing a side profile. They are tall with elongated features, including a prominent nose and chin, and have long, straight hair. They are dressed in a dark, formal suit with a high collar. To the right, another person is kneeling, wearing a laurel wreath and a toga, reminiscent of Julius Caesar. This figure is shown polishing the standing person's shoes with a cloth in hand. The background shows a crowd of onlookers, rendered in a sketchy style, creating an audience observing the scene. The setting appears to be a theatrical or public space.

artworks.title: Par suite de la maladie de la vigne
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures exchanging items. The scene depicts a humorous interaction between the figures. One figure is thin with a large cylindrical basket on its back and holding a goblet. The other figure is burly and rotund with grapes and a draped garment, also holding a goblet. Both figures appear to be engaged in conversation.

artworks.title: Comment, c'est dans cette cave que ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration shows four men leaning over a railing, peering down. Three men are standing on the left, facing right and slightly bending over the railings. The fourth man is on the right, also leaning over with one arm around his back. The men have distinct facial features and exaggerated expressions; two have mustaches and one does not. They have short hair, with two wearing top hats. They wear long coats and trousers with visible folds. One man has a bald spot visible. The background has frames, suggesting it's an art exhibit or gallery. The image has a formal and curious tone, typical of a 19th-century illustration.

artworks.title: Vot' Bourgeois est-y pour liberté de la boucherie?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction in a butcher shop. The scene captures a burly butcher holding a cleaver, leaning over a countertop with cuts of meat visible. The setting is a typical butcher shop with various cuts of meat hanging in the background. The butcher is responding to a woman standing across from the counter, holding a basket. The illustration is done in a caricature style with bold lines and exaggerated features. The caption below reads "la liberté de la boucherie."

artworks.title: Le rues de Paris dans les premiers jours de Septembre ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures: a man, a woman, and a child. The man is wearing a top hat, a long coat, and fitted trousers, and is holding a young girl. The girl has curly hair with a ribbon or flower and is wearing a light-colored dress with puffy sleeves. The woman and the child next to her are shown in traditional attire, with the woman wearing a bonnet and a long gown and the child wearing a bonnet and dress similar to the girl in the man's arms. The woman carries a bouquet of flowers. The background is a simple, shaded area.
